subject: Biology
b6_reason: Juxta medullary nephrons have a long loop of Henle that runs deep into the medulla; their renal corpuscle lies in the cortex close to the medulla, cortical nephrons are the majority (about 85 percent), and the columns of Bertini are cortical extensions between the medullary pyramids.
b6_working: Option 3 is the only true statement; 1, 2 and 4 are each false.
